name: shire-automations
description: Explore Shire Automations services and run stateless workflow planning tools from an MCP-compatible assistant.
long_description: Connect an MCP-compatible assistant to Shire Automations. Read the public services and pricing catalog, list planning tools, and run workflow planning calculations. Tool inputs are sent to Shire Automations' public API for processing and are not stored. The tools do not submit intake forms, create quotes, or start paid work. Do not send credentials or sensitive customer, patient, or financial-account data.

tools.name: shire_catalog
tools.description: Read Shire Automations services, starting prices, and public planning tools.

tools.name: shire_list_planning_tools
tools.description: List workflow planning calculators published by Shire Automations.

tools.name: shire_plan
tools.description: Run a stateless Shire workflow planning calculator using provided values.
